value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Center for Sustainable Energy (CSE), on behalf of SDG&E, under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized statewide budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered across SDG&E's entire distribution territory, which includes Poway.
value.eligibility: PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E residential customers (general market tier)
